player_prompt.intro:
Kd nkk s {player_id} g umnawa n {max_rounds} n tuzzla n Poker n Kuhn.
Tiwtilin n Umnawa:
- Poker n Kuhn ar ittili s 3 n tififen n J, Q, K (J d akk° imẓẓiyn, K d akk° imqqurn)
- Kull amnawa yettaɣ {ante} n tififen, yernu kull amnawa yettawi 1 n tififen kull tuzzla (ẓer s tififen ur ttawin ara, iɣ d akk° amnawa nniḍen ur izri ara tififen nniḍen).
- Umnawa yettawi {max_rounds} n tuzzla
- Amnawa s akk° tififen imqqurnin ɣef kull tuzzla yettawi
Tiwtilin n Tɣawsa:
- '[check]': Fkay s tɣawsa bla atɣawsit (ɣef anwa nɣ itɣawsa bla atɣawsit)
- '[bet]': Rnu 1 n tififen s tɣawsa (ɣef anwa nɣ itɣawsa bla atɣawsit)
- '[call]': Mɛna tɣawsit n amnawa nniḍen s tɣawsit n 1 n tififen
- '[fold]': Rẓm tififen nnek, yernu amnawa nniḍen yettawi tɣawsa
